reviews.title: Easy install works like a charm
reviews.comment: Extremely easy install. Lightening fast. I am extremely happy with this. I will be buying another for my husband's PS5. My games load super fast now. I have had no issues. Fits perfectly.
reviews.author: Sparrow

reviews.title: Runs hotter then the Preditor GM 7000, be aware
reviews.comment: Read these before you buy them, these are not Predator GM 7000, they are Predator GM 7, they run 30 degrees Fahrenheit hotter then the GM 7000's. This is not what you think it is. I like the GM 7000's, these are not the same
reviews.author: Amazon Customer
